title: RP is contained in BPP
statement: Let $E$ be a verifier model and let $L$ be a language of bit strings. If $L$ has an $E$-efficient randomized verifier with polynomially bounded randomness, acceptance probability at least $2/3$ on members, and zero acceptance probability on nonmembers, then it has an $E$-efficient randomized verifier whose acceptance and rejection probabilities on members and nonmembers, respectively, are each at least $2/3$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ has an $E$-efficient verifier with polynomially bounded randomness, member acceptance probability at least $2/3$, and zero acceptance probability on nonmembers
